description: This file defines a struct named SystemTargetGrainId within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It provides functionality to identify, create, parse, and manipulate system target grain IDs, which are used within the Orleans distributed virtual actor system for system target identification and addressing.

classes.name: SystemTargetGrainId
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a system target's grain ID in Orleans, enabling creation, parsing, comparison, and addressing of system target grains.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new SystemTargetGrainId with specified grain type and silo address, optionally including additional string identifier.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId as a SystemTargetGrainId, returning true if successful.

methods.name: WithSiloAddress
methods.description: Returns a new SystemTargetGrainId with the silo address replaced.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the SiloAddress associated with this system target grain ID.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainId (overload 1)
methods.description: Creates a grain ID for a grain service given type code, system ID, and silo address.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainType
methods.description: Creates a GrainType for a grain service with specified type code and system ID.

methods.name: CreateGrainServiceGrainId (overload 2)
methods.description: Creates a grain ID for a grain service with specified grain type and silo address.

methods.name: CreateGrainType
methods.description: Creates a GrainType for a system target with the specified name.
